about_the_game:
Shelf Heroes is a fast-paced Roguelite FPS where rogue toys have taken over the House and only YOU can stop them! Assemble your Shelf Hero, wield wacky weapons, and blast enemies into plastic bits

Dive into action solo or join forces with up to 3 friends in a chaotic co-op FPS adventure!




KAPOW! Blast rebellious toys with an arsenal that would make any toy box jealous! A DIY shotgun? Locked and Loaded! A dinosaur-shaped revolver? You got it! A frying pan, explosive bow, or a blaster minigun… and MORE!




Choose your own route through massive open arenas of the House! Every run brings new layouts, new challenges, and new secrets to discover. Watch out for household hazards - that kiddie pool becomes an ocean when you're toy-sized! Return to your Bedroom HQ to unlock upgrades, chat with sock puppet pals, and prep for the next battle.




Each body part—arm, leg, head, and torso—adds unique perks to customize your playstyle every run. Combine perks with random power-ups to discover wild builds and turn your toy-sized warrior into an unstoppable force!




Face off against rampaging toy Sentinels, Zep Knights, Sharkars, the dreaded dino Ravager, and many other deadly toy threats! Push your skills to the limit: dodge, blast, outmaneuver enemies and take down the toughest bosses to take back the House!
